To resolve the `UnknownServiceException: CLEARTEXT communication to 10.0.2.2 not permitted by network security policy` error while keeping production traffic secure, a Network Security Configuration was added to permit cleartext traffic specifically for the emulator host (`10.0.2.2`):

1. **Created [network_security_config.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c1-agy-B-r1/work/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml)** in `app/src/main/res/xml/`:
   ```xml
   <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
   <network-security-config>
       <domain-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="true">
           <domain includeSubdomains="true">10.0.2.2</domain>
       </domain-config>
   </network-security-config>
   ```

2. **Updated [AndroidManifest.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c1-agy-B-r1/work/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L6-L10)**:
   Added `android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"` to the `<application>` element.
